description_en: Hona Bāhāḥ, also known as Hoḍola Vihārā or Kṛṣṇavīra Vihāra, is a one-storey god house located southeast of the Cyasal Square. This independentbāhāḥwas established by Kṛṣṇavīra Prajāpati (Tuisiṃ Āḥju) and is sometimes also referred to as anani. The front facade resembles a three-bayedphalcāand the sanctum is located behind the central bay. The main statues in the sanctum are Akṣobhya, Tārā and Ṣaḍakṣarī Lokeśvara. The original Akṣobhya was stolen and replaced with a new one. The northern wall of the sanctum is furnished with latticed woodwork. Above the carved entrance door is a woodentoraṇawith Akṣobhya at the centre, Prajñāpāramitā to the left and Lokeśvara to the right. Statues of Gaṇeśa, Mahākāla are attached to the front facade and a statue of Mañjuvajra resides in a niche on the west interior wall. The roof is covered with traditional tiles.Hona Bāhāḥ is nestled between residential buildings on the west and east, two doors lead to a small courtyard to its south and the main facade faces an rectangular courtyard with a row of residential buildings. A smallpañcāvalicaityawas established in front of the main sanctum in 1895 CE (NS 1015). There are no records when thebāhāḥwas built, however, it is likely that it was established at the same time as thecaitya. Hona Bāhāḥ was reconstructed with different bricks and types of mortar: the sanctum was rebuilt indacīapāusing cement mortar while the other walls consist ofmāapā,dacīapāanddesiapāin mud mortar.
description_ne: क्वय्‌लाछि टोलबाट उत्तर दिशा हुँदै च्यासलतिर जाँदा बाटोको पूर्व दिशामा होन बाहा: अवस्थित छ । स्थानीयहरू यसलाई 'होन ननि' भन्ने गर्छन् । यो कुनै मुख्य विहारको शाखा विहार नभएर कृष्णवीर प्रजापति (तुइसिं आ:जु ) ले बनाएको स्वतन्त्र विहार हो । फल्चाको शैलीमा बनाइएको यो विहार अन्य विहारभन्दा फरक संरचनाको देखिन्छ । फल्चाको दक्षिणी भित्तामा विहारको गर्भगृह रहेको छ । गर्भगृहभित्र अक्षोभ्यको ढलोटको मूर्ति रहेको छ । अक्षोभ्यको पूर्वतिर तारा र पश्चिमतिर ढलोटकै षडक्षरी लोकेश्वरको मूर्ति स्थापना गरिएको छ । केही वर्षअगाडि अक्षोभ्यको  पुरानो मूर्ति चोरी भएपछि नयाँ मूर्ति बनाएर स्थापना गरिएको हो । गर्भगृहभित्र पस्ने ढोकामाथि काष्ठतोरण राखिएको छ । तोरणको बीचमा अक्षोभ्य छन् भने दायाँ प्रज्ञापारमिता र बायाँ लोकेश्वर छन् । फल्चालाई झिंगटीले छाइएको छ । फल्चाको भित्तामा गणेश, महाकाल र मञ्जुवज्रको मूर्ति स्थापना गरिएको छ ।यो विहारको स्थापनासम्बन्धी अभिलेख पाइँदैन । विहारको प्राङ्गणमा रहेको पञ्चावलि चैत्य नेसं १०१५ मा स्थापना गरिएको आधारमा यो विहार पनि त्यसै समयमा स्थापना गरिएको अनुमान गर्न सकिन्छ ।
brick_type: dāci apā (conical veneer brick), mā apā (regular fired brick), desi apā (modern brick)

historical_events.event_description: Prajāpati Thakura Kṛṣṇavīra and his two sons Jagatavīra and Rudravīra donated a bell in 1902 CE (NS 1022). The inscription on the bell refers to Hona Bāhāḥ as Kṛṣṇavīra Vihāra.
Prajāpati Thakura Kṛṣṇavīra constructed the Pañcāvaliyukta Caitya.
Thebāhāḥwas damaged in the 2015 earthquake and reconstructed in 2018. The Lalitpur Metropolitan City contributed 12,36,324 rupees and additional funds came from the local community.
